prompt:
Reference image 1 is Mr. Black Hole's current visual-novel sprite and reference image 2 is his model sheet. Draw a NEW sprite of him for the same visual novel, keeping his design, colours and art style identical.
MR. BLACK HOLE - IDENTITY (match reference images exactly): a tall gentleman whose HEAD is a glossy black sphere containing a swirling purple-pink-blue nebula galaxy, with two calm white half-lidded eyes and a small gentle closed-mouth smile. A camel/khaki soft felt fedora with a dark brown band. A dark navy single-breasted suit jacket and trousers, crisp white shirt, no tie. HANDS are dark galaxy-textured tentacle tips coming out of white shirt cuffs. Below the jacket there are NO legs: a cluster of dark galaxy-textured TENTACLES, each tentacle ending in its own black Chelsea ankle boot (about ten boots). Personality: calm, quiet, good-natured, gentle; never gloomy, never cynical, never menacing.
POSE: sitting on an invisible seat (draw NO chair and NO sofa), seen at a slight three-quarter angle, upper body relaxed and turned slightly toward the viewer's left as if watching a television, both tentacle hands resting on his knees. The tentacles with their boots rest on the ground in front of him in a loose relaxed cluster.
EXPRESSION: calm half-lidded eyes, gentle small smile.

STYLE: identical art style to the reference sprite - clean anime line art, soft cel shading, the same colour palette and lighting, same level of detail. Full body from head to toe, the whole figure inside the frame with generous empty space on every side, nothing touching the image edges. Same scale as the reference sprite (the figure fills about 90% of the image height). No text, no watermark, no frame, no props other than those described.
BACKGROUND FOR CHROMA KEY: the subject stands on a perfectly flat solid #ff00ff (pure magenta) background for background removal. One uniform colour, no shadows, no floor, no gradient, no vignette, no reflection, no lighting variation. Crisp clean edges. Do NOT use #ff00ff anywhere on the subject. Vertical portrait 2:3.
